outline: 本課程之設計是用來發展現代各種英語教學法之理論與實務。
schedule:
Week	Topic
1 	Orientation
2	Grammar Translation
3	Direct Method
4	Mock Teaching
5	Audio-Lingual Method
6	Mock Teaching
7	The Silent Way
8	Mock Teaching/ exam questions due
9 	Mid-term exam
10	Desuggestopedia
11	Mock Teaching
12	Communicative Language Teaching
13	Mock Teaching
14	Community Language Learning
15	Mock teaching
16	Total Physical Response
17	Mock Teaching
18 	Final Exam
assessment: Attendance and participation (10%), mock teaching & presentation (30%), (30%), midterm exam (30%), final exam (30%).
